cd /tmp/r2run-e3a05l1d/data/text; cat > $TMPDIR/q.py <<'EOF'
import re,glob,collections
cites=[]
for f in sorted(glob.glob('*.txt')):
    lines=open(f,encoding='utf-8',errors='replace').read().split('\n')
    for i,l in enumerate(lines):
        if 'finds the following' in l:
            j=i+1
            while j<len(lines) and not lines[j].strip(): j+=1
            cites.append((f,j<len(lines) and lines[j].strip()))
print('cases',len(cites))
c=collections.Counter(x[1] for x in cites)
for k,v in c.most_common(): print(v,repr(k))
EOF
python3 -I $TMPDIR/q.py
